title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on Numbers 21: Hormah, the venomous snakes and the bronze serpent, the song of the well, and Israel's victories over Sihon and Og.

questions.text: What was the place called after Israel utterly destroyed the Canaanites of the king of Arad?
questions.explanation: Yahweh delivered up the Canaanites, Israel utterly destroyed them and their cities, and the place was called Hormah.

questions.text: What did the people say about their food when they spoke against God and Moses?
questions.explanation: They said there was no bread or water, and "our soul loathes this disgusting food!"

answers.text: It was better than the food of Egypt
There was too little of it on the Sabbath
Their soul loathed this disgusting food
It made them sick for seven days

questions.text: What did Yahweh send among the people after they spoke against him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh sent venomous snakes among the people; they bit the people and many of Israel died.

questions.text: What did Moses make and set on a pole?
questions.explanation: Following Yahweh's command, Moses made a serpent of bronze and set it on the pole.

questions.text: What happened to a bitten man when he looked at the bronze serpent?
questions.explanation: If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.

answers.text: He became unclean for seven days
He had to leave the camp
He had to offer a ram

questions.text: What did Israel sing at Beer?
questions.explanation: At Beer, the well where Yahweh gave water, Israel sang, "Spring up, well! Sing to it."

answers.text: "Sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously"
"Rise up, Yahweh, let your enemies be scattered"
"The water is sweet, the water is good"

questions.text: Where did Sihon king of the Amorites fight against Israel?
questions.explanation: Sihon gathered all his people, went out against Israel into the wilderness, came to Jahaz and fought against Israel.

questions.text: How far did the land of Sihon that Israel possessed stretch?
questions.explanation: Israel struck Sihon and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon.

answers.text: From the Jordan to the Great Sea
From the Arnon to the Jabbok

questions.text: Which city was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites?
questions.explanation: Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab.

questions.text: Who went out against Israel to battle at Edrei?
questions.explanation: Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
